Summary of discovery:
- Use case: predictive customer support routing (multi-tenant).
- Expected QPS: ~120 peak, average 40.
- Data residency: US only.

Procurement / commercial items we discussed:
1) Preferred payment method: you mentioned procurement usually goes through PO and central purchasing, but engineering buys by card for smaller pilots.
2) Approval users: you expect Finance to sign final agreements; product/engineering own the POC acceptance criteria.
3) Marketplace: you were interested in a cloud marketplace option if it simplifies procurement.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Can you confirm the budget owner and signatory for this project (name & title)? (ACTION: Alex)
- Will this start as card-funded pilot (< $5k) or require a PO/contract from the start? (ACTION: Alex)
- I'll attach a short SOW & estimated pricing for the pilot so Finance can triage. (ACTION: Rohan)

If easier, recommend looping in the finance contact now so we avoid back-and-forth. My calendar is open this week for a 20-min alignment if helpful.

Thanks — Rohan

Priya — great to meet you (virtually). Quick responses on our side: 
- Marketplace: we are listed on AWS Marketplace with private pricing support; we can also do direct PO (Net-30/Net-45) under an enterprise arrangement.
- Typical PO lead time: if procurement has standard vendor checks complete, 2–3 weeks; if they need SOC2 evidence or additional security attestation, add 1–2 weeks.
- Signatory path: for deals under $50k we usually accept PO with VP Finance sign-off; above that we require an MSA signatory + legal review.

Rohan — attaching a one-page pricing addendum to the SOW that shows card pilot SKU + PO pricing tiers. Recommend we send the SOW + pricing + marketplace listing URL to Priya so procurement can triage.
